svg.title: Super Ultra Code Plan execution lifecycle
svg.desc: A request is classified as Spike, Bounded, or Architectural. All paths converge on brainstorming and a visual implementation plan gated by human approval, then route to TDD, systematic debugging, or subagent orchestration with chunk-fan-out-gather-audit loop, pass a verification gate and git hygiene, and close with a session-close debt sweep. A deep research path can inject evidence at any design phase. Compaction preserves state across context resets.
